# modern-screenshot (vendored)

Renders the visible part of a page as an image for problem reports
(`inventory/static/inventory/problem_report.js`). Loaded only when the dialog
opens, not with every page.

| File | Source | Version |
|---|---|---|
| `modern-screenshot.js` | npm `modern-screenshot`, `dist/index.js` (UMD, `window.modernScreenshot`) | 4.7.0 |
